plan.failureSummary: Deterministic replay failed when attempting to locate the cached 'Last Name' input field on an unstable survey form variant.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside generated cache replay file .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js
Failure screenshot shows 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' fields instead of the cached 'Last Name *' selector targets
Used DETERMINISTIC mode with isRetryAttempt = false
The flow overall objective and test doc explicitly account for shifting form layouts across loads

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) and rerun the test in autonomous mode to allow it to dynamically interact with the current form fields.

remediationSteps.summary: Review prompt flexibility if retry fails
remediationSteps.details: If the fresh autonomous execution fails to complete the survey, verify that the prompt instruction covers all dynamic form permutations.

plan.notes: The application dynamically alters form layout and field names across sessions. The cached replay attempted to locate 'Last Name *', but the live page presented 'Your Name *'. Clearing the page.ai cache and retrying in autonomous mode will allow Page.AI to adapt to the current form structure.
